1	(* Layer 2: descent set, descent number, ascent number. *)
2	From mathcomp Require Import all_ssreflect fingroup perm.
3	From mathcomp_eulerian Require Import ordinal_reindex perm_compress.
4	
5	Set Implicit Arguments.
6	Unset Strict Implicit.
7	Unset Printing Implicit Defensive.
8	
9	(* ========================================================================= *)
10	(* Descent predicate and descent set                                         *)
11	(* ========================================================================= *)
12	
13	Section Descent.
14	Variable n : nat.
15	Implicit Types (s : {perm 'I_n.+1}) (i : 'I_n).
16	
17	(* A position i : 'I_n is a descent of s : {perm 'I_n.+1} if               *)
18	(*   s(i) > s(i+1)                                                         *)
19	(* (positions of s are in 'I_n.+1 = {0,...,n}; descents are between         *)
20	(* consecutive positions so i ranges over 'I_n).                           *)
21	
22	Definition is_descent s i : bool :=
23	  s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) > s (lift ord0 i).
24	
25	Definition descent_set s : {set 'I_n} := [set i | is_descent s i].
26	
27	Definition des s : nat := #|descent_set s|.
28	
29	Definition asc s : nat := n - des s.
30	
31	Lemma is_descentE s i :
32	  is_descent s i = (s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) > s (lift ord0 i)).
33	Proof. by []. Qed.
34	
35	Lemma mem_descent_set s i : (i \in descent_set s) = is_descent s i.
36	Proof. by rewrite inE. Qed.
37	
38	Lemma des_le s : des s <= n.
39	Proof. by rewrite /des (leq_trans (max_card _)) // card_ord. Qed.
40	
41	Lemma des_add_asc s : des s + asc s = n.
42	Proof. by rewrite /asc subnKC // des_le. Qed.
43	
44	Lemma des_id : des (1 : {perm 'I_n.+1}) = 0.
45	Proof.
46	apply/eqP; rewrite cards_eq0; apply/eqP/setP => i; rewrite !inE.
47	rewrite /is_descent !perm1; apply/negbTE; rewrite -leqNgt.
48	by apply: ltnW; rewrite /= /bump leq0n add1n.
49	Qed.
50	
51	End Descent.
52	
53	(* ========================================================================= *)
54	(* Interaction with Layer 1: descents and drop_perm                          *)
55	(* ========================================================================= *)
56	
57	Section DescentDrop.
58	Variable n : nat.
59	
60	(* Descents at interior positions are preserved by drop_perm.                *)
61	(* More precisely: for σ : {perm 'I_n.+2} and i : 'I_n, the descent of       *)
62	(* drop_perm σ at i corresponds to the descent of σ at widen_ord i.           *)
63	
64	Lemma is_descent_drop (s : {perm 'I_n.+2}) (i : 'I_n) :
65	  is_descent (drop_perm s) i = is_descent s (widen_ord (leqnSn _) i).
66	Proof.
67	rewrite /is_descent.
68	rewrite -(ltn_lift (s ord_max) (drop_perm s (lift ord0 i))
69	                                (drop_perm s (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i))).
70	rewrite !lift_drop_permE.
71	have hi : (i : nat) < n.+1 by apply: ltnW (ltn_ord i).
72	have hi2 : (n.+1 <= i) = false.
73	  by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltnW (ltn_ord i).
74	have hi3 : (n.+1 <= i.+1) = false.
75	  by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.
76	have bi : bump n.+1 i = i by rewrite /bump hi2.
77	have bi1 : bump n.+1 i.+1 = i.+1 by rewrite /bump hi3.
78	have E1 : lift ord_max (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i)
79	        = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) :> 'I_n.+2.
80	  by apply/val_inj => /=; exact: bi.
81	have E2 : lift ord_max (lift ord0 i)
82	        = lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) :> 'I_n.+2.
83	  apply/val_inj => /=.
84	  rewrite /bump.
85	  rewrite leq0n /= add1n.
86	  by rewrite hi3 add0n.
87	by rewrite E1 E2.
88	Qed.
89	
90	End DescentDrop.

rewrite -(ltn_lift (s ord_max) (drop_perm s (lift ord0 i))

have hi2 : (n.+1 <= i) = false.
  by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltnW (ltn_ord i).

  by apply/negbTE; rewrite -ltnNge; apply: ltn_ord.

        = widen_ord (leqnSn _) (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) :> 'I_n.+2.

        = lift ord0 (widen_ord (leqnSn n) i) :> 'I_n.+2.
